high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "thinkaboutmaps." The post features a satellite image of a volcanic eruption on the island of La Palma, Spain. The image shows a vivid red lava flow extending from the volcano down towards the coastline, with smoke or ash trailing behind it. The surrounding landscape includes green vegetation and some urban areas near the coast. The post has received 6,386 likes. The caption reads: "Satellite image of the lava flow generated by the ongoing eruption on the island of La Palma, Spain.
